title: Reshoring schedule.
officialText:
A signed and sealed reshoring schedule shall be provided and maintained at the
construction site whenever reshoring is employed.
Exception: A separate reshoring schedule is not required when the required reshoring information is covered on the
approved construction documents prepared by the applicant of record.
